items.source: 1 A detailed listing of the attributes of a Person resource, identified as #person-representation, lists the names of the attributes. 2 The supported operations. This one indicates how to create a new Person. 3 The name is persons, which indicates (because it is plural) that a POST should be applied to the whole collection, not a single person. 4 The type is UNSAFE, because this operation can alter the state of the system. 5 The rt is #person-representation, which indicates that returned resource type will be Person resource.
items.translation:
1一份详细列出了被标识为#person-representation的Person资源的属性的清单，其中列出了这些属性的名称。
2支持的操作。此项指示如何创建一个新的Person。
3name为persons，由于它是复数形式，这表明 POST 操作应应用于整个集合，而不是单个person。
4type为UNSAFE，因为此操作可能会改变系统的状态。
5rt为#person-representation，这表明返回的资源类型将是Person资源。

items.source: 1 The value of rest.description.person maps into the whole representation. 2 The value of rest.description.person.firstName maps to the firstName attribute. 3 The value of rest.description.person.lastName maps to the lastName attribute. 4 The value of rest.description.person.id maps to the id attribute, a field not normally displayed. 5 The value of rest.description.person.address maps to the address attribute.
items.translation:
1 rest.description.person 的值映射到整个表示。
2 rest.description.person.firstName 的值映射到 firstName 属性。
3 rest.description.person.lastName 的值映射到 lastName 属性。
4 rest.description.person.id 的值映射到 id 属性，这是一个通常不显示的字段。
5 rest.description.person.address 的值映射到 address 属性。

items.source: Application-Level Profile Semantics (ALPS)
items.translation: 应用级配置文件语义（ALPS）

items.source: ALPS is a data format for defining simple descriptions of application-level semantics, similar in complexity to HTML microformats. An ALPS document can be used as a profile to explain the application semantics of a document with an application-agnostic media type (such as HTML, HAL, Collection+JSON, Siren, etc.). This increases the reusability of profile documents across media types.
items.translation: ALPS 是一种用于定义应用级语义简单描述的数据格式，其复杂度类似于 HTML 微格式。ALPS 文档可用作配置文件，以解释具有非特定于应用的媒体类型（如 HTML、HAL、Collection+JSON、Siren 等）的文档的应用语义。这提高了配置文件文档在不同媒体类型之间的可重用性。
